name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'epic/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  release-version-integrity:
    name: Release version integrity
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
      github.actor == 'github-actions[bot]' &&
      github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'github-actions[bot]' &&
      github.event.pull_request.base.ref == github.event.repository.default_branch &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'release/v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read

    steps:
      - name: Check out trusted release validation
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |-
            scripts/validate-release-pr.mts
            scripts/release-github-evidence.mts
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Validate version-only release change
        env:
          GITHUB_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          RELEASE_PR_MODE: pre-merge
          RELEASE_PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: node scripts/validate-release-pr.mts

  verify:
    name: Verification (Linux)
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      issues: read
      pull-requests: read

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          # Architecture validates the exact event base/head and accepted epic history.
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run policy, type, and test verification
        env:
          HVIR_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: npm run verify

  electron-smoke:
    name: Electron smoke (Linux)
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run production Electron workflow
        env:
          HVIR_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts/production
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke

      - name: Run development renderer Performance Timeline containment
        env:
          HVIR_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts/development-performance
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke:development-performance

      - name: Prove failure and interruption isolation
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke:isolation

      - name: Upload bounded Electron failure evidence
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ci-electron-smoke-failure-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  macos-electron-smoke:
    # Temporary reduced gate: terminal-presentation, terminal-lifecycle, and capacity
    # remain available through local commands while their macOS flakes are hardened.
    name: Electron correctness (macOS arm64; temporary reduced gate)
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run focused unpackaged Electron scenarios
        env:
          HVIR_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts/macos-ci
        run: npm run smoke:macos:ci

      - name: Upload bounded macOS Electron failure evidence
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ci-macos-electron-smoke-failure-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  codeql:
    name: CodeQL analysis
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      packages: read
      security-events: write

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v4.37.9
        with:
          languages: javascript-typescript

      - name: Analyze
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v4.37.9

  merge-acceptance:
    name: Merge acceptance
    needs:
      - release-version-integrity
      - verify
      - electron-smoke
      - macos-electron-smoke
      - codeql
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Check out exact head for base ancestry proof
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Require one coherent CI attempt
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci-attempt-evidence.mts

      - name: Require exact candidate ancestry
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          if [[ ! "$BASE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ || ! "$HEAD_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::Pull request base and head must be full commit SHAs"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" != "$HEAD_SHA" ]; then
            echo "::error::Merge acceptance did not check out the exact pull request head"
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA"; then
            echo "::error::The tested pull request base is not an ancestor of its head"
            exit 1
          fi

  return {

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'epic/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  release-version-integrity:
    name: Release version integrity
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
      github.actor == 'github-actions[bot]' &&
      github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'github-actions[bot]' &&
      github.event.pull_request.base.ref == github.event.repository.default_branch &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'release/v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read

    steps:
      - name: Check out trusted release validation
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |-
            scripts/validate-release-pr.mts
            scripts/release-github-evidence.mts
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Validate version-only release change
        env:
          GITHUB_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          RELEASE_PR_MODE: pre-merge
          RELEASE_PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: node scripts/validate-release-pr.mts

  verify:
    name: Verification (Linux)
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      issues: read
      pull-requests: read

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          # Architecture validates the exact event base/head and accepted epic history.
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run policy, type, and test verification
        env:
          HVIR_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: npm run verify

  electron-smoke:
    name: Electron smoke (Linux)
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run production Electron workflow
        env:
          HVIR_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts/production
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke

      - name: Run development renderer Performance Timeline containment
        env:
          HVIR_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts/development-performance
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke:development-performance

      - name: Prove failure and interruption isolation
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke:isolation

      - name: Upload bounded Electron failure evidence
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ci-electron-smoke-failure-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  macos-electron-smoke:
    # Temporary reduced gate: terminal-presentation, terminal-lifecycle, and capacity

    runs-on: macos-15

      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run focused unpackaged Electron scenarios
        env:
          HVIR_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts/macos-ci
        run: npm run smoke:macos:ci

      - name: Upload bounded macOS Electron failure evidence
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ci-macos-electron-smoke-failure-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

    name: CodeQL analysis
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    permissions:

      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v4.37.9
        with:
          languages: javascript-typescript

      - name: Analyze
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v4.37.9

    name: Merge acceptance
    needs:
      - release-version-integrity
      - verify
      - electron-smoke
      - macos-electron-smoke
      - codeql
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    permissions:
      actions: read

      - name: Check out exact head for base ancestry proof
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Require one coherent CI attempt
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci-attempt-evidence.mts

      - name: Require exact candidate ancestry
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          if [[ ! "$BASE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ || ! "$HEAD_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::Pull request base and head must be full commit SHAs"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" != "$HEAD_SHA" ]; then
            echo "::error::Merge acceptance did not check out the exact pull request head"
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA"; then
            echo "::error::The tested pull request base is not an ancestor of its head"

import { DEVELOPMENT_PERFORMANCE_MEASURE_POLICY_ID } from './src/renderer/src/development/performance-measure-budget'
import type { ApplicationBuildChannel } from './src/shared'

function excludeDevelopmentPerformancePolicyFromProduction(): Plugin {
  return {
    name: 'exclude-development-performance-policy-from-production',
    apply: 'build',
    generateBundle(_options, bundle): void {
      const retainedPolicy = Object.values(bundle).find(
        (output) =>
          output.type === 'chunk' &&
          output.code.includes(DEVELOPMENT_PERFORMANCE_MEASURE_POLICY_ID),
      )
      if (retainedPolicy) {
        this.error(
          `Production renderer chunk ${retainedPolicy.fileName} retained development Performance Timeline policy`,
        )
      }
    },
  }
}

function excludeSmokeRuntimeFromProduction(smokeBuild: boolean): Plugin {
  return {
    name: 'exclude-smoke-runtime-from-production',
    apply: 'build',
    generateBundle(_options, bundle): void {
      if (smokeBuild) return
      for (const output of Object.values(bundle)) {
        if (output.type !== 'chunk') continue
        const smokeModule = Object.keys(output.modules).find((moduleId) =>
          moduleId.replaceAll('\\', '/').includes('/src/main/smoke/'),
        )
        if (smokeModule) {
          this.error(
            `Production main chunk ${output.fileName} retained smoke module ${smokeModule}`,
          )
        }
        if (output.code.includes('HVIR_SMOKE')) {
          this.error(
            `Production main chunk ${output.fileName} retained the HVIR_SMOKE activation path`,
          )
        }
      }
    },
  }
}

import type { HostPath } from './host-path'
import { repositoryImageMimeType } from './rendered-link'
import type { TextWorkload } from './viewer-workload-policy'

export type ViewMode = 'rendered' | 'source' | 'diff'

export type DiffBase = 'working-tree' | 'head' | 'branch-point'

export interface WriteFileRequest {
  readonly path: HostPath
  readonly content: string
  /** Omitted for recovered drafts that have no trustworthy disk version. */
  readonly expectedMtimeMs?: number
}

export interface WriteFileResponse {
  readonly path: HostPath
  readonly size: number
  readonly mtimeMs: number
}

export interface GitDiffRequest {
  readonly path: HostPath
  readonly base: DiffBase
  /** Commit whose parent/current blobs form a historical diff. */
  readonly revision?: string
}

export interface GitDiffResponse {
  readonly path: HostPath
  readonly base: DiffBase
  readonly revision?: string
  readonly baseLabel: string
  readonly currentLabel: string
  readonly baseInput: TextWorkload
  readonly currentInput: TextWorkload
}

/**
 * The one extension point for the smart default in ADR-007. Keep inference
 * deterministic and visible rather than scattering file-type exceptions
 * through UI components.
 */
export type FileOpenContext = 'file-tree' | 'created-file' | 'git' | 'git-untracked'

export function defaultViewMode(
  path: HostPath,
  context: FileOpenContext = 'file-tree',
): ViewMode {
  if (context === 'created-file') return 'source'
  if (context === 'git') return 'diff'
  const name = path.path.toLowerCase()
  const extension = name.includes('.') ? name.slice(name.lastIndexOf('.') + 1) : ''
  return RENDERED_EXTENSIONS.has(extension) ? 'rendered' : 'source'
}

export function canRender(path: HostPath): boolean {
  return defaultViewMode(path) === 'rendered'
}

export type RenderedFileType =
  'markdown' | 'mermaid' | 'html' | 'json' | 'yaml' | 'csv' | 'image'

export function renderedFileType(path: HostPath): RenderedFileType | undefined {
  const name = path.path.toLowerCase()
  const extension = name.includes('.') ? name.slice(name.lastIndexOf('.') + 1) : ''
  if (repositoryImageMimeType(name)) return 'image'
  if (extension === 'md' || extension === 'mdx' || extension === 'markdown') {
    return 'markdown'
  }
  if (extension === 'mmd' || extension === 'mermaid') return 'mermaid'
  if (extension === 'htm' || extension === 'html') return 'html'
  if (extension === 'json') return 'json'
  if (extension === 'yaml' || extension === 'yml') return 'yaml'
  if (extension === 'csv') return 'csv'
  return undefined
}

const RENDERED_EXTENSIONS = new Set([
  'htm',
  'html',
  'json',
  'yaml',
  'yml',
  'markdown',
  'md',
  'mdx',
  'mermaid',
  'mmd',
  'csv',
  'avif',
  'bmp',
  'gif',
  'ico',
  'jpeg',
  'jpg',
  'png',
  'svg',
  'webp',
])

*** Add File: README.md
+# hvir
+
+hvir is a desktop workbench for software projects and terminal-based coding
+agents. It keeps local or SSH-hosted workspaces, terminals, source review, and
+Git context together in one Electron application.
+
+## Features
+
+- **Local and remote workspaces** — open folders on the local machine or connect
+  through aliases in `~/.ssh/config`. hvir remembers projects, discovers Git
+  worktrees, and restores workspace state.
+- **Terminal workbench** — run native PTYs in tabs and split layouts with search,
+  configurable themes, attention indicators, and session recovery.
+- **Coding-agent harnesses** — create launch profiles for Claude Code, Codex,
+  Cursor CLI, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Pi, a plain shell, or a custom
+  command. Profiles can be global or project-specific.
+- **Repository browser and viewer** — manage files and inspect them in source,
+  rendered, or diff modes. Rendered previews support Markdown, Mermaid, HTML,
+  JSON, YAML, CSV, and common image formats.
+- **Review workflow** — edit files, inspect blame and diffs, and capture inline
+  document-review feedback without leaving the workbench.
+- **Integrated Git tools** — browse changes, history, and the commit graph;
+  switch branches; fetch and pull; and move between related worktrees.
+- **Session overview** — monitor live terminal sessions across workspaces and
+  return directly to an exact session.
+- **Embedded web panes** — open loopback development services alongside the
+  terminal and source viewer.
+
+## Requirements
+
+- macOS or Linux
+- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) 24 or newer
+- npm and Git
+- Python and a C/C++ build toolchain supported by
+  [`node-gyp`](https://github.com/nodejs/node-gyp)
+
+The selected local or remote host must also contain any shell, Git installation,
+or coding-agent CLI that you want to use there.
+
+CI currently exercises Ubuntu 24.04 and macOS 15 on Apple silicon. Packaging is
+configured for macOS arm64 (`.pkg`) and Linux x64/arm64 (`.deb`); the repository
+does not currently define a Windows package target.
+
+## Getting started
+
+Install dependencies and start the development build:
+
+```bash
+npm ci
+npm run dev
+```
+
+`npm ci` downloads Electron and rebuilds the native terminal dependencies for
+Electron's ABI. On first launch, hvir asks you to choose a project folder.
+

+# hvir
+
+hvir is a desktop workbench for software projects and terminal-based coding
+agents. It keeps local or SSH-hosted workspaces, terminals, source review, and
+Git context together in one Electron application.
+
+## Features
+
+- **Local and remote workspaces** — open folders on the local machine or connect
+  through aliases in `~/.ssh/config`. hvir remembers projects, discovers Git
+  worktrees, and restores workspace state.
+- **Terminal workbench** — run native PTYs in tabs and split layouts with search,
+  configurable themes, attention indicators, and session recovery.
+- **Coding-agent harnesses** — create launch profiles for Claude Code, Codex,
+  Cursor CLI, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Pi, a plain shell, or a custom
+  command. Profiles can be global or project-specific.
+- **Repository browser and viewer** — manage files and inspect them in source,
+  rendered, or diff modes. Rendered previews support Markdown, Mermaid, HTML,
+  JSON, YAML, CSV, and common image formats.
+- **Review workflow** — edit files, inspect blame and diffs, and capture inline
+  document-review feedback without leaving the workbench.
+- **Integrated Git tools** — browse changes, history, and the commit graph;
+  switch branches; fetch and pull; and move between related worktrees.
+- **Session overview** — monitor live terminal sessions across workspaces and
+  return directly to an exact session.
+- **Embedded web panes** — open loopback development services alongside the
+  terminal and source viewer.
+
+## Requirements
+
+- macOS or Linux
+- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) 24 or newer
+- npm and Git
+- Python and a C/C++ build toolchain supported by
+  [`node-gyp`](https://github.com/nodejs/node-gyp)
+
+The selected local or remote host must also contain any shell, Git installation,
+or coding-agent CLI that you want to use there.

+configured for macOS arm64 (`.pkg`) and Linux x64/arm64 (`.deb`); the repository
+does not currently define a Windows package target.
+
+## Getting started
+
+Install dependencies and start the development build:
+
+```bash
+npm ci
+npm run dev
+```
+
+`npm ci` downloads Electron and rebuilds the native terminal dependencies for
+Electron's ABI. On first launch, hvir asks you to choose a project folder.
+
+To select a local project at startup:

+```bash
+HVIR_PROJECT_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/project npm run dev
+```

+For a remote project, add a concrete host alias to `~/.ssh/config`, restart hvir,
+and choose that host from **Connect to a host**. hvir uses configured identity
+files or `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` and prompts for authentication or host trust when
+needed.
+

+
+| Command | Purpose |
+| --- | --- |
+| `npm run dev` | Start Electron with Vite hot reload |
+| `npm run build` | Type-check and create a production build |
+| `npm run build:dir` | Create an unpacked application in `dist/` |
+| `npm test` | Run the Vitest unit suite |
+| `npm run test:watch` | Run Vitest in watch mode |
+| `npm run lint` | Run ESLint |
